reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The EBRD signed an equity commitment of EUR 20 million to Taxim Capital Partners I LP (the "Fund") in July 2016 and is making an additional equity commitment of up to EUR 10 million. The Fund is a Jersey limited partnership and targets EUR 200 million of total capital commitments. The Fund will seek to generate long-term capital appreciation through control-oriented equity investments into fast growing medium-sized companies in Turkey. The Bank's participation will help mobilise additional private sector investment in the Fund.
